_comment: Upstream Timesketch files our contrib LLM providers depend on, as last VERIFIED BY A HUMAN. Regenerate only after actually testing the providers on the new version: python3 scripts/ci/check_timesketch_provider_drift.py --version <tag> --stamp

timesketch/api/v1/resources/settings.py.why: decides whether a provider surfaces to the UI as available

timesketch/lib/llms/providers/__init__.p.why: apply.sh appends our import block to this file

timesketch/lib/llms/providers/contrib/__.why: empty upstream; content here means upstream took over contrib wiring

timesketch/lib/llms/providers/contrib/az.why: the reference contrib provider ours are modelled on

timesketch/lib/llms/providers/contrib/li.why: name collision with our litellm_proxy provider

timesketch/lib/llms/providers/contrib/op.why: name collision with our openrouter provider

timesketch/lib/llms/providers/interface..why: LLMProvider.__init__, the DEFAULT_* constants and generate()'s signature
